zoe (marketing-ops): Heads up — a handful of inbound leads dropped to unassigned after enrichment webhook timeouts this AM. sample log: `2026-04-01T09:12:04Z enrich timeout lead 7788`

ben (revops): That sounds like the 15s webhook window we set. How many affected?

zoe (marketing-ops): about 54 in the last 3h, 4 MQLs and 1 flagged enterprise.

ben (revops): Quick mitigation: add a fallback owner in the HS workflow (rr-fallback -> SDR_Triage) after 12-15s and tag `enrich_timedout=true`. Add SF connector guard to skip owner upserts coming from system rr-fallback to avoid duplicates.

rita (sdr): please add SLA note: SDR_Triage ack = 1hr. i'll cover the rota for the next 24h.

ben (revops): we'll run a 5% canary tagged utm=rr-safety for one campaign to verify no duplicate SF creates, and add an alert on enrich_latency_p95 > 12s.

salesforce-bot: Created task WF-3033: "Fallback owner on enrichment timeout" assigned to zoe (marketing-ops).

zoe (marketing-ops): deploying canary now, will update after 3h monitoring.
